Trying to buy cold medicine without getting sick shouldn't be this difficult.

A quick trip to the pharmacy turns into a nightmare when the cold medicine aisle is apparently the preferred hangout spot for people with every symptom imaginable.

All I wanted was some medicine. Instead, I met a couple of extremely contagious people who seem very determined to share absolutely everything.

If you want to see the let's play of me and Dave, watch here ▶️ https://youtu.be/JGm2CvqQbuQ  And don't forget to Subscribe if you want more gaming content!
